title: Lapinux configuration catalog
description: Generated by tools/catalog.py. Do not edit catalog.json by hand. Each entry is a configuration manifest plus the generated 'base' and 'size' fields.

version.description: Catalog format. Lapinux accepts older catalogs but always publishes version 2.

base.description: Repository folder of the entry; files are fetched relative to it.

size.description: Total size of the entry's files, in bytes.

items.description: A configuration manifest plus the generated fields. Validate one entry with schema/configuration.schema.json.
